title: bookkit series manifest (manifest_version 1)
description: Contract for a project's series.yaml: the shared facts of a multi-volume book and the ordered volume list. Every field except 'volumes' is a default that a volume's manifest.yaml may override.

manifest_version.description: Contract version of the series manifest itself; only 1 exists.

collection.description: Name of the series; passed to pandoc as the 'collection' metadata variable.

author.description: Shared default; a volume's author overrides it.

publisher.description: Shared default; a volume's publisher overrides it.

rights.description: Shared default; a volume's rights overrides it.

language.description: Shared default; a volume's language overrides it. The tool restricts it to the toolkit's supported codes (en, es, pt, gl).

volumes.description: Ordered list of volume directory names, relative to the series directory. The order is significant: it is the build and reading order.
